_comment: Derived values from RESEARCH_LATTICE_ECDLP_ROUTES.md section 6. Group order N ~ p; factor base F = {x(P) < B}, B = p^beta, m summands. theta_m = 2/((m+1) 2^(m-1)) is the Coppersmith (Jochemsz-May basic strategy, box Newton polytope, per-variable degree 2^(m-1)) ceiling on prod X_i = p^theta. beta_max = theta_m/m. e_rel = 1 - (m-1) beta_max is the exponent of decomposition attempts; e_la = 2 beta_max the sparse linear-algebra exponent. theta_needed = m/(2(m-1)) is the root-region exponent at which e_rel would reach rho's 1/2. 'oracle' rows take theta = 1 (uniqueness ceiling; the lattice step is then the decomposition problem itself). gaudry_weil_descent is Gaudry 2009's exponent 2(n-1)/n^2 for E(F_{q^n}) with n = m, available over extension fields only (not over F_p). Nothing here is measured.
